candidate.name: Ignacio Arsuaga
candidate.startAvailability: Target start availability: late August to early September 2026, subject to USCIS approval and EAD issuance

hero.label: Made for Gooseworks
hero.headline: I want to be the first growth hire who actually runs the playbook.
hero.subheadline: Gooseworks is doing something I have not seen before: giving AI agents real operating context so growth work can actually scale without scaling headcount. I spent the last year doing cold outreach, LinkedIn sequences, and B2B research by hand, and I know exactly which parts of that work beg to be systematized. I want to be inside a company that is building the infrastructure to do it.

whyCompany.title: AI coworkers with memory and tools changes how growth teams operate
whyCompany.body: Most AI sales tools bolt onto existing workflows as a feature. Gooseworks is building something closer to a new kind of teammate, one that owns context, channels, and skills end to end. That shift from AI as a tool to AI as a coworker is the most interesting bet in growth right now, and I want to work at the company making it real.

whyCompany.title: Founding Growth Engineer means the playbooks do not exist yet
whyCompany.body: Gooseworks is at the stage where the growth engine has not been codified, and the first person in this seat gets to build it from scratch. That is not a support role, it is a founding contribution. Being early enough to turn customer growth experiments into the self-serve playbooks that define how the product is sold is exactly the kind of leverage I am looking for at 21.

whyCompany.title: My BDR and NextAfter work is direct preparation for this seat
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach sequences in HubSpot, built LinkedIn campaigns, and helped close 10 to 12 paying clients from scratch without a playbook to follow. At NextAfter I moved into B2B digital fundraising consulting, working on the research and messaging side of how organizations acquire and convert audiences. Both experiences taught me what growth looks like before it is systematized, which is exactly where Gooseworks operates.

quote: I have spent two years doing growth work that should have been a Gooseworks playbook. Now I want to be the person who builds those playbooks for everyone else.
